🎥🎬: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse (2023)

Miles Morales is trying to balance life as Spider-Man with being a teenager when he is reunited with Gwen Stacy. She introduces him to the Spider Society, a group of Spider-People from across the multiverse who protect the stability of their different realities.

Miles soon discovers that the Spider Society believes certain tragic events are supposed to happen in every Spider-Man’s story. When Miles learns that someone he loves is destined to become a victim, he refuses to accept that fate.

Determined to save his loved ones, Miles breaks away from the Spider Society and finds himself chased across multiple dimensions. As different Spider-People take sides, Miles must find his own path and prove that his story doesn’t have to follow the rules of the multiverse.
